in_marathi.name: Poojani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prayers
in_marathi.long_meaning: Poojani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Poojani is derived from the Sanskrit word 'poojana' which means 'to offer prayers'. This name is often given to a girl born in a Hindu family who is believed to be a Goddess in her own right, and is blessed with the ability to bring happiness and blessings to her family and community through her prayers and devotion.
